integrity: The infinite phase-count statement is proved analytically by reversible elimination and monotonicity.
Finite numerical checks are corroborative only and do not establish the theorem.
The source correspondence between positive solutions of the normalized system and translation-invariant splitting Gibbs measures is used as stated in the primary paper.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only positive translation-invariant boundary-law solutions in the ferromagnetic soft-core model.
It does not classify periodic or non-translation-invariant Gibbs measures, extremality, reconstruction, or free-energy dominance.
A weakly indexed equivalent derivation remains a residual originality risk.
title: Exact phase-count classification for the ferromagnetic Widom–Rowlinson boundary law
